The '''Rogue Houses''' were the [[Tapani Noble Houses|Noble Tapani Houses]] that opposed [[Shey Tapani]] during the [[Unification War]]. The rogue houses were eventually defeated at the [[Battle of Shindra's Veil]]. Two were destroyed, while the third, the [[House Nidantha]], fled the newly christened [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].
